completion_data.completion_summary: Synced 95 stale context files, copied 11 missing extension files, added 3 hook scripts, updated nvim/nix manifests with hooks and plan routing, merged index.json from 106 to 150 entries, and backported 4 permissions plus hook timeouts to .claude/settings.json.

memory_candidates.content: When syncing content from .claude/ to .opencode/, use `sed 's|\.claude/|.opencode/|g'` for path-prefix substitution in file content. For index.json, use a jq script that applies walk(gsub) substitution on all string values rather than per-field substitution. The complex redirect approach (command > file) silently fails in bash scripts; use a separate script file with chmod +x and run it with `bash scriptfile`.
